propositions: docs/exit-codes.md declares itself single source of truth but documents only 41 of 75 real dispatcher commands, omitting review-plan, review-code, verify-completion and others
Exit codes 75 (RebaseGuard/EXIT_RESCHEDULE) and 78 (StoreIncompatibleError) reach process exit status but are undocumented in the table; code 75 is used by CI workflows
Codes 3, 4, 12 and validate command's 0-4 severity bucket lack documentation
The document's scope note incorrectly states only five commands validate unknown options; metrics, doctor, composer and fsck also exit 2 on unknown options
No machine-readable source exists for per-command exit semantics, requiring manual documentation maintenance with conformance testing
